parameters.name: backendServiceName
parameters.description: The backend service name. You can use this name to filter routes.

parameters.name: consumerAuthorizationRuleId
parameters.description: Filters the API list by a specific consumer authorization rule ID. The response includes only authorized APIs.

parameters.name: deployStatuses
parameters.description: The deployment status of the route.

parameters.name: domainId
parameters.description: Filters route information by domain name ID.

parameters.name: forDeploy
parameters.description: Specifies whether this is a deployment scenario.

parameters.name: httpApiId
parameters.description: The HTTP API ID. This is a path parameter and is required. If not provided, the request URL cannot be constructed. You can obtain valid values from versionedHttpApis[].httpApiId returned by ListHttpApis. This parameter must point to an HTTP API of type Http, HttpIngress, or WebSocket. The Rest type does not support route operations.

parameters.name: pageNumber
parameters.description: The page number, starting from 1. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: The page size. Valid range: 1 to 100. Default value: 10.

parameters.name: withAuthPolicyInfo
parameters.description: Includes consumer authorization information in the response.

parameters.name: withConsumerInfoById
parameters.description: Includes the authorization rule list of the specified consumer ID for each route in the response.

parameters.name: withPluginAttachmentByPluginId
parameters.description: Includes the plug-in attachment information of the specified plug-in ID for each route in the response.
